row:
An educational platform dedicated to neuro physiotherapy, rehabilitation, movement and functional independence.

We share accessible, evidence-informed content to create awareness about neurological conditions, rehabilitation, recovery, movement and everyday function — for patients, caregivers, families, students and healthcare professionals.

Rebuilding movement. Restoring confidence. Renewing independence.

पुनः नवा | Where healing begins and hope returns.

Disclaimer: Content is for general education and awareness only and does not replace individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
